manifest.name: nvfp4-blockfit-gdn-fp8-qkv12-51-attn-q4k-lmhead-q4k
manifest.description: #93 (FP8 recurrent qkv 1-63, attention on runtime Q4_K, nvfp4_blockfit on every other NVFP4 projection, lm_head fitted once: RP-KL 0.0743, decode 89.3) with the FP8 qkv narrowed to layers 12-51 (30 of the 47 GDN layers). Each FP8 qkv layer costs about 0.13 tok/s of decode, but its drift gain is not spread evenly: the mid-depth layers lower drift most per byte (#63, #74), and the gain saturates as more of the recurrent path goes to 8 bits (#86 to #88, #32 to #92). Keeping the shallow and deepest qkv on blockfit NVFP4 should give back about 2.2 tok/s decode, 0.7k prefill and 0.3 GiB while keeping most of #93's drift gain: a point between #93 and #83 (0.0849, decode 91.3) that neither covers.
